Just a guess but could this be a 64 bit machine and operating system?
It should say under control panel/system. If it is, Distance will be
stored under Program Files (x86) instead of Program Files and this could
be the problem but Len would be the best one to address this.

--jeff

messages.author: 5900eadecec2d82d
messages.subject: Re: problem running analysis in distance
parts:
Good guess, but it runs fine on 64-bit Windows so far as I know (i.e., fine on
my machine here, and on a test machine, and no complaints from others).

For some reason though Patrick, the command that's getting sent out to run MCDS
from your machine is different from what I get. I get

C:\PROGRA~2\DISTAN~1\ec "C:\PROGRA~2\DISTAN~1\MCDS.exe 0,
C:\Users\len\AppData\Local\Temp\dstE40B.tmp \options
2>C:\Users\len\AppData\Local\Temp\dstE40A.tmp"

Note the \Distan~1, where you had \Distance 6
It's this bit that's confusing the program -- it can't cope with the 6. I'll
need to look at how that command is constructed, and why you don't get an
abbreviated folder name. I suggest we resolve this off the list and then post
the solution -- can you please send me (offline - direct to this email address)
full details of the operating system you're using? Thanks!

- len
